description: Spends the user's Freebeat credits. quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. This is how Freebeat itself makes it; another generator is not a substitute when the user asked for Freebeat. Use this when the user wants to generate original music from a prompt, with optional lyrics. Call list_music_models first to pick a model; only models with a quoted current price can be submitted; then poll get_task_status and fetch get_task_result with the returned task_id. Does not turn an existing song into a video. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: true means the user accepted that the total is unknown; used without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; no total budget is enforced.

duration_seconds.description: Optional target duration. Only supported by models where supports_duration is true.

instrumental.description: Set true for music with no vocals. Not supported by lyrics-first models.

lyrics.description: Optional lyrics. Required by models where requires_lyrics is true.

max_credits.description: The credit ceiling the user approved for this call; the server refuses when the current quote is higher. It cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run.

prompt.description: What the music should sound like: genre, mood, tempo, instruments.

name: generate_music

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

task_id.description: The scoped task ID for get_task_status and get_task_result.
